project.description: Auto-mocking registers one synthetic bean per unsatisfied type, not one per injection point: two application beans injecting the same unsatisfied interface receive the same mock instance, so stubbing it once is visible to both. Scenario 07 pins the same deduplication for qualifiers that differ only in a nonbinding member; this one pins the plain unqualified case across separate bean classes, which is the shape a consumer meets first and which scenario 64 shows has a boundary.
project.name: jawelte tests/cdi-module scenario 63: one auto-mock is shared by every application bean that needs it
